additional_info.subject: RE: ID0472797-DC/Si-D/DE- [Y2/T94002909175] OCPP Issue CRM:03289000276
additional_info.body:
Good Mr. Huber,
I am reaching out in regards of ticket
ID0472797,
opened for an unexpected StopTransaction on charger
Y2/T9 4002909175.
I took a look at the session reported, and I saw that the StopTransaction was sent by the charger while attempting to start a charging session, due to a timeout on the LEM.
This is a bug that was already identified from our R&D department, and it is solved in our latest FW v8.1.4.
This morning I successfully updated the charger to FW v8.1.4.
Since the issue is solved by the new FW release, I will proceed to close the ticket.
Thank you!
With kind regards,
Fosco Servidei
Siemens AG
eMobility Customer Service
Technical Support Engineer
